rule: Nothing derived from these tasks may enter fine-tune training data: no solutions from any model, no near-duplicate tasks, no repo code that copies a solution. They are the before/after eval set for every fine-tune arm.

amendments.change: stretch: run_length_encode -> run_length_encode_v2 (the same task; v1 retired to benchmarks/retired/ because its expected output was the old lossy show). v1 moves to retired_excluded so its banked solutions stay out of training.
